summary_en: Ebara announced an additional share buyback program to acquire up to 1.7 million shares for a maximum 5.0 billion yen over November 16 to December 31, 2026, representing 0.4% of outstanding shares, bringing the total fiscal 2026 buyback ceiling from 10.0 billion yen to 15.0 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Ebara's board of directors authorized an additional share buyback program under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's Articles of Incorporation. The company will acquire up to 1.7 million common shares for a maximum 5.0 billion yen through market purchase via a broker contract between November 16 and December 31, 2026. This represents 0.4% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of October 31, 2026, based on 455,397,470 shares in circulation.

This additional buyback tranche increases the total fiscal 2026 buyback ceiling from 10.0 billion yen to 15.0 billion yen. A previous framework set in February 2026 with a 10.0 billion yen limit and 3.0 million share cap was completed on August 3, 2026. The stated purpose is to optimize the capital structure and enhance long-term shareholder value in line with the newly formulated medium-term business plan.
